Counsel,

Attached is our initial markup of the Confidential Settlement Agreement. edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff a total settlement amount of USD 42,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds no later than five (5) business days after the Effective Date. Plaintiff’s obligation to release claims under Section 2 is conditioned upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds. If Defendant fails to timely pay the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff may enforce this Agreement and recover reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement.
edits.name: Payment amount and mechanics

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant arising out of or relating to the matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the action, whether known or unknown, through the Effective Date; provided that Plaintiff does not release any rights to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Release conditioned on cleared funds

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed by either party except to its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, regulators, or as required by law, court order, subpoena, or for purposes of enforcing this Agreement, provided that any permitted recipient is informed of the confidential nature of the terms to the extent reasonably practicable.
edits.name: Confidentiality with standard carve-outs

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or responsibility by any party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No admission clarification

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff a total settlement amount of USD 42,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds no later than ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. Defendant’s obligation to pay the Settlement Amount is a material obligation under this Agreement and is not released or discharged by Section 2. If Defendant fails to timely pay the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall provide Defendant written notice of such failure, and Defendant shall have five (5) business days after receipt of such notice to cure by paying all unpaid amounts in full in cleared funds. If Defendant fails to cure within that five (5) business-day period, Plaintiff’s sole remedy for such nonpayment shall be to enforce this Agreement, and Plaintiff may recover reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement.
edits.name: Payment timing; notice and cure; enforcement remedy

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Effective upon execution of this Agreement by all parties, and except for the obligations and rights created by or reserved in this Agreement, including Plaintiff’s right to receive and enforce payment of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff and Defendant each fully and finally releases and forever discharges the other party and its respective current and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, attorneys, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, expenses, and obligations of any kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the action through the Effective Date. Plaintiff’s sole remedy for any nonpayment of the Settlement Amount shall be enforcement of this Agreement as provided in Section 1.
edits.name: Mutual release effective on execution with enforcement carve-out

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed by either party except to its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, regulators, officers, directors, finance personnel, lenders, affiliates, or other representatives with a need to know, or as required by law, court order, subpoena, or for purposes of enforcing this Agreement. Each party shall inform permitted recipients of the confidential nature of the terms to the extent reasonably practicable and, where reasonably practicable, shall cause such permitted recipients to be bound by confidentiality obligations consistent with this Section.
edits.name: Confidentiality recipient categories and practicable confidentiality obligations
